reviews: XIPHIAS SuperFoods has truly revolutionized the way I approach my health. The black rice is now a weekly staple.
Natural and organic offerings with a real commitment to quality and purity. Delivery to Dubai was smooth.
Made it incredibly convenient for me to lead a healthier lifestyle. The masala tea is the best I've had outside Assam.
Exceptional organic catalogue and direct sourcing from farmers. You can taste the difference in the makhana.
address: 1st Floor, JK Nirmala Arcade, Plot 780, 80 Feet Rd, 4th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru 560034
